# hiok_event_stream (Resource)

An Event Mesh stream: partitioned event ingest that stays replayable.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Stream name.
- `namespace_id` (String) Owning namespace (product must be pulse).

### Optional

- `partition_count` (Number) Partitions; determines read parallelism.
- `retention_hours` (Number) How long events stay replayable.

### Read-Only

- `events_in` (Number) Events published so far.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
